python3 -c "
import humanize
import datetime as dt

# R3: Test overflow handling
print('=== R3: Overflow tests ===')
try:
    # Very large timedelta
    result = humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(seconds=999999999999999))
    print(f'Large timedelta: {result}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'ERROR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

try:
    # naturaltime with huge integer seconds
    result = humanize.naturaltime(999999999999999)
    print(f'Huge seconds: {result}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'ERROR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Also test naturaldelta directly with huge value
try:
    result = humanize.naturaldelta(999999999999999)
    print(f'naturaldelta(huge int): {result}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'ERROR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# R4: Unit export check
print('\n=== R4: Unit export check ===')
print(f'Unit available: {hasattr(humanize, \"Unit\")}')
if hasattr(humanize, 'Unit'):
    print(f'Unit: {humanize.Unit}')
    print(f'Unit.SECONDS: {humanize.Unit.SECONDS}')
"
